verdict.rationale: Atlas's own docs say its online incorporation package includes a registered agent to meet Delaware compliance requirements, and one founder contrasts Atlas favorably with a prior incorporation that had hidden registered-agent costs. Nothing shows a standalone purchase of the service, disclosure of the agent's exact name and street address, same-day turnaround, or use for change filings rather than Atlas's own formation. Missing for 10: standalone registered-agent purchase, documented delivery of the exact agent name and street address, same-day availability, support for change/amendment filings, independent hands-on corroboration.
